answer: Discount grading cliques: after each epoch every validator rebuilds a public graph where an edge means one identity graded or attested another, then flags clusters whose positive grades mostly stay inside the cluster. Flagged grades lose weight and future seats are drawn so members never grade each other. That removes the kernel of a farm's profit, praising its own work; each extra fake must win grades from strangers, like marbles that must come from other jars. Limit: a close honest group, such as a lantern-making guild, may be flagged, so it gets an appeal before rewards freeze.
